transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Streaming Event Producer. We've got the final greenlight meeting coming up for the awards stream this Saturday at 8:00 PM, including the proposed live fan-voting finale. I know the audience tech team is estimating up to 15,000 remote viewers may try to participate, so we need to make sure we're ready for that scale. Before I can give my final approval and lock the plan, we'll need both the broadcast-standards review and the audience-technology readiness review completed, with each review lead reading their confirmed requirements into the record using the formal review disclosure. Once both reviews are done, I'll go through my final sign-off checklist — crediting every confirmed review source the locked plan relies on — before I close the meeting. Let's get started whenever everyone's ready.
